title: Administrator
description:
Legal Administrator - Temp to Perm

Location: York, YO1
Salary: 28,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm
Contract: Temporary to Permanent

About the Role

We are recruiting for an Administrator to join a busy solicitors' firm based in York city centre.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous administration or office support experience who is looking for a long-term position. You don't need to have worked in a legal environment, as full support will be provided, but you should be organised, proactive and confident handling a variety of administrative tasks.

Key Responsibilities
- Photocopying, scanning and preparing documents
- Preparing paperwork and correspondence
- Assisting with invoices and accounts administration
- Opening and maintaining files
- Obtaining documents and carrying out online searches
- Chasing clients and third parties by telephone and email
- Providing general administrative support to the wider team

What We're Looking For
- Previous administration or office support experience
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- Confidence using Microsoft Office and computer systems
- A professional telephone manner
- A positive attitude and the ability to work well within a team

Benefits
- 20 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays, increasing to 30 days with service
- 3 additional days off between Boxing Day and New Year
- Christmas Eve off when it falls on a normal working day
- An additional day off for your birthday after successful completion of probation
- Company pension and sick pay schemes, subject to eligibility
- Potential bonus scheme
- Subsidised parking
- Cycle-to-work scheme and corporate travel benefits
- Employee referral scheme offering up to 1,000 per referral
- Discounts on legal services and other in-house services, subject to qualifying periods

If you're an organised administrator looking for a varied role with the opportunity to secure a permanent position, we'd love to hear from you!

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Consortium Professional Recruitment are working with an established organisation in Pocklington to find a Finance Assistant who enjoys being involved, taking responsibility and making sure things happen when they should. You'll be joining a team where your contribution will be valued, with the opportunity to work across several areas of finance rather than being limited to one particular task.

The Opportunity:
As a Finance Assistant, you'll be involved in the financial activities that help keep a busy organisation running effectively.

You'll have the opportunity to:
- Process accurate monthly payroll, including PAYE, workplace pensions, P60s and P11 Ds.
- Maintain purchase and sales ledgers, process invoices, expenses and supplier payments, and assist with credit control.
- Complete bank and credit card reconciliations, administer petty cash and maintain fixed asset records.
- Support month-end and year-end activities, VAT returns and annual accounts preparation.
- Your work will directly contribute to a well-organised finance function, supporting informed decisions and helping the wider organisation operate with confidence.

About You:
You might already be working in an accounts team, supporting payroll or handling a mixture of finance responsibilities. What's important is that you're comfortable with numbers, enjoy finding solutions and can be relied upon to follow things through.

We're particularly interested in hearing from people who bring:
- Practical experience in finance or payroll, with an understanding of how accurate financial information supports a business.
- The confidence to work with spreadsheets, financial systems and detailed information.
- A methodical approach, with the ability to spot when something doesn't look quite right.
- The initiative to manage your own workload while knowing when to ask questions or involve others.
- A friendly, professional manner and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Knowledge of Sage or Xero would be useful.

If you're studying towards AAT that's an added bonus.

The Benefits and Package:
In return, you'll enjoy:
- £29,000 to £32,000 depending on experience.
- Life insurance, healthcare scheme, company pension and 25 holidays + bank holidays
- A broad role offering exposure to payroll, financial accounting, reporting and audit processes.
- Opportunity to develop your career and complete further qualifications.
- Collaborative team working alongside an experienced and supportive Finance Manager

How to Apply:
If you're a Finance Assistant looking for a role with greater variety, or you're currently working in accounts or payroll and ready for your next move, we'd be pleased to hear from you!

This exciting Finance Assistant / Payroll Administrator opportunity is being managed by Consortium Professional Recruitment, a trusted recruitment partner with a Human First approach.

If you're ready to take the next step in your finance career, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.

Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd are a professional level recruitment consultancy specialising in the delivery of high relevance recruitment services on behalf of our clients across the UK. We regularly receive large responses to our advertising which can make providing individual feedback to every applicant challenging. If you haven't received a reply from us within 14 days of your application, we regret to say your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We have a policy of retaining your details for future vacancies unless you request otherwise. To learn more about our services, please visit consortiumrecruitment.co.uk

title: HR Administrator
description:
Sewell Wallis is looking for an HR Administrator to join a professional services business, based on-site just near Wetherby.

You ll have 4-5 years' experience in HR/recruitment and have a good understanding of employment law and HR requirements. It is not necessary that you have a CIPD qualification, but that would benefit an application. This role would suit someone who is keen to progress, learn and get stuck into the business; you ll have a positive can-do attitude and work closely with the HR director day-to-day.

Responsibilities include supporting employee relations and case management, maintaining accurate HR records and systems, processing contracts and leavers, and ensuring compliance with employment legislation and data protection requirements.

What will you be doing?
- Employee Relations: Provide administrative support for employee relations matters, including disciplinary, grievance and performance cases, arranging meetings, preparing documentation, taking accurate notes and maintaining confidential records.
- Recruitment: Support the end-to-end recruitment process, including preparing job adverts, screening applications, coordinating interviews, communicating with candidates and supporting hiring managers.
- Onboarding & Offboarding: Coordinate new starter processes, including contracts, right-to-work checks, DBS checks where required, inductions and probation reviews, as well as supporting leavers and internal employee changes.
- HR Administration: Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, including holiday, sickness, absence, contract and employee information, ensuring records are updated accurately and within required deadlines.
- Employee Support: Act as a first point of contact for routine HR queries, providing support to employees and managers regarding HR processes, policies, pay, benefits and employment documentation.
- Training & Compliance: Coordinate training and e-learning activities, support performance and absence management, maintain HR policies and job descriptions, and assist with health and safety and compliance activities.
- Payroll & Benefits: Support payroll, benefits, salary reviews and employee changes by providing accurate information, preparing documentation and liaising with relevant internal teams.
- Reporting & Data Protection: Prepare HR reports and metrics, maintain effective filing and document retention systems, and ensure HR processes and records comply with data protection, confidentiality and internal policies.

What skills are we looking for?
- Confident written and verbal communication skills, with a friendly, professional and approachable manner.
- Experience working within an HR or business administration setting.
- Strong organisational and administrative abilities, with excellent attention to detail.
- A basic understanding of UK employment law and HR policies.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.
- The ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
- Experience assisting with or coordinating meetings, especially those relating to employee relations.
- Currently studying towards, holding, or interested in pursuing a CIPD Level 3 qualification.
- Based locally to the office and able to travel independently using your own transport.

What's on offer?
- £28,000 - £30,000 starting salary
- 20 days annual leave plus 8 statutory bank holidays, with the addition of Christmas shutdown and your birthday off!
- Company pension scheme
- Company sick pay
- Parking available

Send us your CV below, or contact Inci Evcil for more information.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry. We offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance, from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. We are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: HR Assistant (Maternity Cover)
description:
HR Assistant (Maternity Cover)
York/Hybrid
£24,839.36 per annum (FTE £31,049.20 per annum)
12 Months Fixed Term Contract, Part Time (28 hours per week)

We re looking for an organised and proactive HR Assistant to join our People Shared Services team on a 12-month maternity cover contract.

About the role

Working as part of a busy People Team, you ll provide a high-quality HR administration service across the employee lifecycle, supporting areas including recruitment, employee changes, absence, learning and development and employee benefits.

You ll maintain accurate and confidential employee records, process new starters and changes on our HR and payroll system, prepare contracts and other HR documentation and respond to queries from colleagues, candidates and managers. You ll also support pre-employment and compliance checks, including right to work, references and DBS checks, as well as Occupational Health referrals and regular data audits.

As a first point of contact for general HR enquiries, you ll provide straightforward guidance on policies and processes, escalating more complex matters where appropriate. You ll also have the opportunity to support wider People Team projects and identify ways we can continue to improve our systems and processes.

This is a varied role where accuracy, organisation and great customer service are key.

About you

You ll have solid experience of HR administration within a busy environment and a good understanding of employment legislation and HR processes. Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities, you ll have excellent attention to detail and be confident working accurately to deadlines. You ll be a strong communicator who can build positive relationships with colleagues at all levels and provide a friendly, professional and responsive service.

You ll be comfortable using Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and Outlook, as well as HR software systems, and will be confident handling sensitive and confidential information. You ll be proactive, flexible and willing to use your initiative to solve problems and improve ways of working.

A CIPD/Level 3 qualification would be advantageous but are not essential.

How to apply

If you share our passion and this role sounds like you, then we re looking forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and supporting information via our online application platform.

The closing date for applications is 8th November 2026

Interviews will take place on tbc

We reserve the right to bring the closing date forward should enough quality applications be received prior to the current closing date.

Additional Information

Applications are welcome from all, regardless of age, disability, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, religion or belief, race, sex, sexual orientation, trans status or socioeconomic background.

We positively encourage applications from people from marginalised backgrounds, including but not limited to those with experience of living in poverty.

We are committed to being an anti-racist organisation and operate an anonymised recruitment process so that bias is eliminated from the shortlisting process.

In support of our approach to flexible working, we are happy to receive applications from those seeking full-time employment, as well as those who may want to share the role on a part-time basis. When making your application, please state whether you want to be considered for either full or part-time work and, if part-time, the number of hours per week you would be looking for.

At JRF we re at our best when we re continually building on trust, showing we care and making a difference and hope others will do the same. So, for those roles which allow it, we re developing a more blended approach to how and where you work. This means you can expect to work flexibly between the office and home with an expectation of one day in the office a week.

We offer a supportive and flexible workplace. For details about our benefits click here: JRF Benefits

We are a Disability Confident Employer. This means that we are committed to the recruitment, progression and retention of disabled individuals. We shall also offer interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the job. If you have a disability, please tell us if you would like to be considered for an interview under the Disability Confident Scheme.

If you have any additional needs and need reasonable adjustments to be made to the interview process, please let us know.
